How to Play

Goal: Survive as many waves as you can! Do not let your lives run out. Keep goblins away from the end.

Instructions: Place towers to stop the onslaught of goblins from reaching the end. Use gold to place new towers and upgrade existing ones, and gems to unlock permanent bonuses in the Gem Skill Tree.
